DSH Teacher editable Word equations / Word 可编辑公式

This application uses mathml2omml 0.5.0 by Johannes Wilm, licensed under the
GNU Lesser General Public License, version 3 or (at your option) any later
version. The library and its use are covered by that license. This packet
accompanies both the teacher-workbench npm package and the Windows installer.
The library is distributed without warranty; see COPYING.LGPL-3 and
COPYING.GPL-3 for the complete terms. DSH Teacher's MIT license does not
relicense this library.

You may modify the library and reverse engineer the combined application to
debug such modifications. No application signing key, activation key, or
application rebuild is required to load an interface-compatible replacement.

Corresponding source

The unmodified upstream source is provided alongside this notice:
  mathml2omml-0.5.0-source.tar.gz
  https://github.com/fiduswriter/mathml2omml
  commit 0ddeb8b59ff1a97796b25d8f682dfb410febde1d
  SHA-256 7c0578339e8af7ef06553a9cc0e5b7500b52905f36d2a8435e34c3c6f9f4b8e9

The converter bundles entities 6.0.1 by Felix Böhm (BSD-2-Clause). Its complete
published package, including TypeScript source, is supplied as entities-6.0.1.tgz:
  https://github.com/fb55/entities
  SHA-256 a4de957ab0852f6c91eae59a6000ced5a25a04f0b6e1c3062fbad732a6b5479d
  See COPYING.entities for its copyright and license.

The parser is derived from html-parse-stringify by Henrik Joreteg under MIT;
COPYING.html-parse-stringify preserves its copyright and permission notice.
The upstream source archive also preserves its test fixtures' separate notices.
DSH Teacher applies the accompanying colors.patch (2026-09-19) to preserve
inherited foreground and background colors on native runs and structural control
characters, native math alphabet/style properties, upright function names, and
bar structures, and n-ary operands and emphasis. It also decodes attribute
entities and escapes XML text and attributes to retain comparison operators
and ampersands. Apply this patch to the upstream source before rebuilding. The runtime
bundle patch is pinned by pnpm-lock.yaml; the source patch contains every local
algorithm change. All library modifications retain LGPL-3.0-or-later.

Rebuild the library

Install Node.js with npm and a tar utility. Copy this packet to a writable
directory. From that directory, run the following commands; npm downloads the
build tools declared by the upstream package, while entities uses the local copy:

  tar -xzf mathml2omml-0.5.0-source.tar.gz
  cd mathml2omml-0ddeb8b59ff1a97796b25d8f682dfb410febde1d
  patch -p1 < ../colors.patch
  npm install --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund --no-save ../entities-6.0.1.tgz
  npm run transpile
  node -e 'require("node:fs").copyFileSync("src/index.d.ts", "dist/index.d.ts")'

After applying the supplied patch, edit src/ as desired and repeat the last two commands. The runtime entry is
dist/index.js; it exports mml2omml and MML2OMML. Build-tool versions can change
generated bytes without changing the interface.

Install a replacement

Close DSH Teacher completely, including its backend. In the directory containing
DSH Teacher.exe, the external library lives at:
  resources/app/node_modules/mathml2omml
Keep a backup of that directory. Replace its dist/ directory with your rebuilt
dist/ directory, retaining the package.json that selects dist/index.js as an ES
module. Reopen DSH Teacher and generate or re-recognize an example's Word document
to use the replacement; previously saved Word documents keep their existing bytes.
Restore the backup to undo the replacement. An application update may replace
your library changes, so retain your modified source separately.

For a Node installation, resolve the library from the installed teacher-workbench
package's package.json with Node's createRequire and replace the resolved
mathml2omml package's dist/ directory while the Host is stopped. Restart the Host
through its normal dsh profile. No additional application launcher is needed.

Source for DSH Teacher and its application build instructions is available at:
  https://github.com/wsl189/dsh-teacher
  https://github.com/wsl189/dsh-teacher/blob/v1.2.4/apps/desktop/README.md
Redistributors retain the library notices and licenses and provide corresponding
source and installation information for their actual distributed library version.

中文说明

本应用使用 Johannes Wilm 的 mathml2omml 0.5.0，以 LGPL 第 3 版或您选择的后续版本发行。
该库及其使用受此许可约束，不提供担保。完整条款见 COPYING.LGPL-3 和 COPYING.GPL-3；
应用自身的 MIT 许可不改变该库的许可。您可以修改此库，并为调试这些修改对组合应用进行逆向工程。

本目录附有未修改的上游完整源码和构建配置，以及编译时内含的 entities 6.0.1 源码包。
COPYING.entities 保留其 BSD-2-Clause 许可；COPYING.html-parse-stringify 保留解析器的 MIT 许可。
安装 Node.js、npm 和 tar 后，在可写目录按上面的命令解压、安装构建工具并生成 dist/index.js。

完全退出应用及后台后，备份安装目录下 resources/app/node_modules/mathml2omml，
将其中 dist/ 替换为重新构建的 dist/，保留原 package.json，再启动应用。
替换兼容接口的库不需要应用签名密钥、激活密钥或重新构建整个应用。重新生成或识别例题 Word
会使用替换后的库，已保存的 Word 不会自动重写。恢复备份即可撤销替换；应用更新可能覆盖修改。
再次发行时须保留许可声明，并提供实际发行版本的对应源码和安装替换说明。

本包随附 colors.patch，保留公式文字、结构符号的前景色与背景色继承，以及数学字母体、字重属性和求和等运算的操作数结构和运算符加粗；同时解码属性实体并转义 XML 文本与属性，保留比较符号和与号。重建前按上述命令
将补丁应用到原版源码。补丁包含全部本地算法修改，并遵循原 LGPL-3.0-or-later 许可。
